description_en: Queries the status of a consumer group, including online client information, message consumption rate, message accumulation count, and last message consumption time
description_zh: 查询某个消费组的状态，包括在线客户端信息、消息消费速率、消息堆积数、最近消息消费时间
kebab_example: aliyun iot query-consumer-group-status --iot-instance-id iot-cn-0pp1n8t0000 --group-id nJRaJPn5U1JITGf000000 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: QueryConsumerGroupStatus

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- If an ID value is available, you must specify this **ID** value. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If the **Overview** page or **ID** value is not available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。

><notice>
- 若有ID值，必须传入该**ID**值，否则调用会失败。
- 若无**实例概览**页面或**ID**值，则无需传入。

></notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The consumer group ID. This ID is returned after you call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/170388.html to create a consumer group. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/170419.html to query the consumer group ID by consumer group name. You can also view the consumer group ID in the IoT Platform console by navigating to the corresponding instance and choosing **Message Forwarding** > **Server-side Subscription** > **Consumer Groups**
parameters.help_zh: 消费组ID。调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/170388.html创建消费组成功后，会返回消费组ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/170419.html按消费组名称查询消费组ID，也可以在物联网平台控制台对应实例下，选择**消息转发**>**服务端订阅**>**消费组列表**，查看消费组ID
parameters.name: group_id
